products.title: Digital Oval Gear Flow Meter
products.shortDesc: Digital oval gear flow meter with high accuracy,real-time display,multiple outputs,and industrial reliability.
products.fullDesc:
The Digital Oval Gear Flow Meter from Broil Sensotek Industries is a positive displacement volumetric flow meter engineered for precise liquid flow measurement across a wide range of industrial applications. It operates using two precision-machined oval gears that rotate within a measuring chamber, trapping and transferring a fixed volume of liquid with each revolution. This principle delivers high accuracy, excellent repeatability, and reliable performance, even with low flow rates and high-viscosity fluids.
The flow meter features an integrated digital display for real-time flow monitoring and supports multiple industrial communication and control outputs, including 4–20 mA, Pulse, RS-485, HART, Alarm, and Frequency outputs for seamless integration with PLC, DCS, and SCADA systems. It is available in mechanical, digital, pulse-output, and remote-display configurations to meet diverse process requirements.

products.title: Mechanical Oval Gear Flow Meters
products.shortDesc: Mechanical oval gear flow meter with resettable counter for accurate, reliable liquid flow measurement.
products.fullDesc:
The Mechanical Oval Gear Flow Meter from Broil Sensotek Industries is a positive displacement volumetric flow meter designed for accurate and repeatable measurement of liquid flow without requiring electronic display components. It operates using two precision-machined oval gears housed within a measuring chamber. As liquid passes through the meter, the gears rotate, transferring a fixed volume of fluid with every revolution, ensuring highly accurate volumetric measurement across varying flow conditions and fluid viscosities.
The flow meter incorporates a mechanical totalizing counter that provides direct local indication of total flow and features a resettable register for convenient batch measurement and dispensing applications. For process automation requirements, the meter is optionally available with a pulse output sensor, allowing integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, batch controllers, and remote monitoring systems.

Manufactured in anodized aluminum, SS316L stainless steel, or PPS, the meter is available in DN4 to DN150 line sizes with threaded or ANSI/ASME/DIN/JIS flanged connections. It supports operating pressures up to 250 bar, temperatures from −50°C to 200°C, and provides measurement accuracy of ±0.2% or ±0.5% of reading. Standard output options include Pulse, 4–20 mA, HART, RS-485, Alarm, while protection and hazardous-area certifications include IP67, ATEX, Ex ia, and Ex d.

products.title: Oval Gear Flow Sensor
products.shortDesc: Pulse output oval gear flow sensor for precise liquid flow measurement and automation integration.
products.fullDesc:
The Oval Gear Flow Sensor from Broil Sensotek Industries is a positive displacement volumetric flow sensor engineered for accurate measurement of liquid flow in industrial automation and process control applications. Operating on the twin oval gear principle, the sensor measures a fixed volume of liquid during each gear rotation and generates proportional pulse signals for highly repeatable and precise flow monitoring. It is particularly suited for both low- and high-viscosity liquids, maintaining excellent accuracy regardless of variations in viscosity or temperature.

Designed specifically for OEMs, batching systems, and industrial control applications, the sensor features pulse output with NPN and PNP options, enabling seamless integration with PLC, HMI, SCADA, DCS, and batch controllers. Its compact, robust construction ensures reliable operation in demanding industrial environments while providing low maintenance and long service life.

The flow sensor is available in DN4 to DN250 sizes with a measurement range from 0.1 to 3000 L/min, making it suitable for a broad spectrum of liquid flow applications. It delivers excellent repeatability and high measurement accuracy while supporting automation systems requiring real-time monitoring, process optimization, and predictive maintenance.

Typical applications include oil, diesel, lubricants, petroleum products, chemicals, food processing, pharmaceuticals, batching systems, dispensing equipment, fuel monitoring, resin, adhesives, and other high-viscosity liquid processes, where dependable pulse-based flow measurement is essential for accurate control and operational efficiency.

products.title: Vortex Sandwich Flow Meter
products.shortDesc: Compact sandwich vortex flow meter for accurate steam, gas, and liquid flow measurement.
products.fullDesc:
The Broil Sandwich Vortex Flow Meter is a compact vortex shedding flow meter engineered for accurate measurement of steam, gases, and low-viscosity liquids in industrial process applications. Operating on the Kármán vortex principle, the meter detects vortices generated by fluid flowing past a bluff body, with the vortex frequency directly proportional to the flow velocity, enabling reliable volumetric and mass flow measurement.

Its sandwich (wafer) connection design provides a compact, lightweight, and space-saving installation between pipeline flanges, making it ideal for applications with limited installation space. The meter contains no moving parts, resulting in minimal maintenance, long service life, and stable long-term performance. Optional pressure and temperature compensation enables accurate mass flow measurement under varying process conditions.

The instrument supports 4–20 mA, Pulse, HART, RS-485, and Alarm outputs, allowing seamless integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, and industrial automation systems. It is available with single or dual displays, pressure and temperature compensation options, and construction materials including SS304, SS316, Cast Steel, PTFE-lined, and Nylon-lined versions for corrosive and demanding environments.

Typical applications include steam boilers, compressed air systems, industrial gases, HVAC, water treatment, chemical processing, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, and utility monitoring, where reliable, maintenance-free, and cost-effective flow measurement is required.

products.title: Vortex Flow Meter
products.shortDesc: Industrial vortex flow meter for accurate steam, gas, air, and liquid flow measurement with smart outputs.
products.fullDesc:
The Broil Vortex Flow Meter is an intelligent flow measurement instrument based on the Kármán vortex shedding principle, engineered for accurate measurement of steam, gases, air, and low-viscosity liquids. As fluid passes a bluff body, alternating vortices are generated at a frequency proportional to the flow velocity, enabling precise and maintenance-free flow measurement without moving parts. This robust measuring principle provides long-term stability, excellent repeatability, and minimal pressure loss.

The flow meter is available with flange, sandwich, and threaded process connections and supports pressure and temperature compensation for accurate mass flow measurement of steam and gases. Users can choose integral or remote display versions with single or dual displays to suit various installation requirements.

Designed for seamless industrial automation, the instrument provides 4–20 mA, Pulse, HART, RS-485, and Alarm outputs, enabling direct integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, and industrial monitoring systems. It is manufactured using Cast Steel, SS304, SS316, PTFE-lined, and Nylon-lined wetted materials, making it suitable for corrosive chemicals, aggressive gases, steam, and general industrial services.

The Broil Vortex Flow Meter is widely used in boiler steam measurement, compressed air systems, industrial gas distribution, HVAC, chemical processing, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, power plants, utilities, and water treatment, delivering reliable performance with optional hazardous-area certifications for demanding industrial environments.

products.title: Digital Turbine Flow Meters
products.shortDesc: Digital turbine flow meter with LCD display, high accuracy, smart outputs, and battery or DC operation.
products.fullDesc:
The Digital Turbine Flow Meter from Broil Sensotek Industries is a precision velocity-based liquid flow meter designed for accurate measurement of low-viscosity conductive and non-conductive liquids. It operates by converting the rotational speed of a precision turbine rotor into an electronic signal, which is processed by an intelligent transmitter to provide real-time flow rate, totalized flow, and process data on an integrated digital display.

The instrument features a high-visibility LCD display with instantaneous and cumulative flow indication, data logging capabilities, and optional pressure and temperature compensation. It supports multiple industrial communication protocols including Pulse, 4–20 mA, RS-485, HART, and Alarm outputs, enabling seamless integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, and Industrial IoT systems. Available in battery-powered and externally powered versions, it provides reliable operation for both remote and fixed installations.

Constructed using SS304, SS316, Cast Steel, and PTFE-lined materials, the digital turbine flow meter is suitable for demanding industrial environments. It offers high repeatability, fast response, low pressure loss, and long-term measurement stability, making it ideal for continuous process monitoring. Hazardous-area options include ATEX, Ex d, Ex ia, and Legal Metrology approvals for custody transfer and regulated applications.

Typical applications include petroleum products, diesel, water, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, dairy, solvents, batching systems, industrial process control, and OEM equipment, where accurate digital flow monitoring and remote communication are essential.

It operates by converting the rotational speed of a precision turbine rotor into proportional pulse signals, providing highly accurate and repeatable flow measurement for financial transactions involving petroleum products, chemicals, and other high-value process liquids.

Designed for hazardous industrial environments, the sensor features ATEX-certified explosion-proof construction with corrosion-resistant materials and hardened turbine components for long service life. The sensor delivers real pulse outputs for direct integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, batch controllers, and remote monitoring systems, enabling accurate billing, inventory management, and process automation. Its rugged construction ensures dependable operation under demanding process conditions while maintaining excellent long-term measurement stability.

The custody transfer turbine flow sensor is available with threaded and flanged process connections and supports operating pressures up to 250 bar with service temperatures from −20°C to +150°C. It offers ±1% linear accuracy, ±0.5% repeatability, and supports industrial communication options including Pulse, 4–20 mA, HART, RS-485, and Alarm outputs. Multiple protection options such as IP65, IP68, Ex d, Ex ia, and ATEX certifications make it suitable for explosive and hazardous locations.

Typical applications include petroleum terminals, fuel loading skids, oil & gas facilities, chemical plants, refineries, pharmaceuticals, fuel monitoring, batching systems, and commercial custody transfer installations, where accurate, traceable, and legally compliant flow measurement is essential.

products.title: Electromagnetic Flow Meter
products.shortDesc: Electromagnetic flow meter for accurate conductive liquid measurement with smart digital communication.
products.fullDesc:
The Electromagnetic Flow Meter from Broil Sensotek Industries is a high-performance flow measurement instrument designed for conductive liquids such as water, wastewater, chemicals, slurries, acids, alkalis, dairy products, and pharmaceutical fluids. Operating on Faraday's Law of Electromagnetic Induction, the flow meter accurately measures volumetric flow without moving parts, resulting in excellent reliability, minimal maintenance, and negligible pressure loss.

Available in both integral (inbuilt display) and remote transmitter configurations, the flow meter provides a digital intelligent display for real-time flow rate, totalized flow, and diagnostics. It supports advanced industrial communication protocols including 4–20 mA, Pulse, Frequency, RS-485, HART, and Alarm outputs, enabling seamless integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, and Industrial IoT systems. Optional BTU (Heat Energy) measurement with dual temperature sensors is available for HVAC and thermal energy monitoring applications.

The instrument offers extensive material options, including SS316, Hastelloy C, Hastelloy B, Titanium, Tantalum, and Platinum electrodes, along with PTFE, PFA, Rubber, and Ceramic liners, making it suitable for highly corrosive and abrasive process fluids. It is available for pipe sizes ranging from DN12 to DN2500, supports operating pressures up to 70 bar, and temperatures up to 180°C. Protection options include IP65, IP68, Ex db, and Ex ia, ensuring reliable operation in harsh and hazardous industrial environments.

Typical applications include water treatment, wastewater management, chemical processing, food & beverage, dairy, pharmaceuticals, HVAC energy management, mining, pulp & paper, and industrial process automation, where accurate, maintenance-free flow measurement of conductive liquids is essential.

The Helical Rotor Flow Meter from Broil Sensotek Industries is a positive displacement flow meter engineered for precise measurement of low- to high-viscosity liquids, thermic fluids, and corrosive or non-corrosive media. Its helical rotor mechanism displaces a fixed volume of liquid during each rotation, providing highly accurate volumetric flow measurement independent of viscosity variations, making it ideal for demanding industrial applications.

Designed for continuous industrial operation, the flow meter features an integrated display with optional Pulse, 4–20 mA, HART, RS-485, and Alarm outputs, enabling seamless integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, and process automation systems. It is available in stainless steel 316, titanium, and aluminum construction to suit aggressive chemicals, thermic fluids, petroleum products, and high-temperature applications. The instrument is also available with battery-powered or externally powered display units and supports Legal Metrology (Weights & Measures) compliance and ATEX certification for hazardous locations.

The Helical Rotor Flow Meter delivers excellent repeatability, low pressure drop, long service life, and maintenance-free operation, making it suitable for custody transfer, batching, loading/unloading skids, fuel transfer, and process control applications. Typical industries include oil & gas, power generation, food processing, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, adhesives, paints, marine, and energy, where accurate measurement of viscous liquids is essential.

products.title: Swirl Flow Meter
products.shortDesc: Dual-sensor swirl flow meter for accurate air and gas measurement with built-in compensation.
products.fullDesc:
The Swirl Flow Meter from Broil Sensotek Industries is a precision gas and air flow measurement instrument based on the swirl (dual vortex sensor) principle. Unlike conventional vortex flow meters, it incorporates two sensing elements to improve measurement stability, repeatability, and accuracy, particularly at low flow rates. The frequency of the generated swirl vortices is proportional to the flow velocity, enabling reliable measurement of air and industrial gases.

The flow meter features an integrated display with optional pressure and temperature compensation, allowing direct measurement of compensated flow values under varying process conditions. It supports industrial communication protocols including 4–20 mA, Pulse, RS-485, HART, and Alarm outputs, enabling seamless integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, and industrial automation systems. Battery-operated and externally powered versions are available for flexible installation.

Designed for demanding industrial environments, the swirl flow meter is available in aluminum construction for non-corrosive gases and SS316 construction for corrosive and high-pressure gas applications. With no moving parts, it provides excellent long-term reliability, minimal maintenance, low pressure loss, and high repeatability. Typical applications include compressed air, natural gas, nitrogen, oxygen, chemical processing, food & beverage, pharmaceutical, utility monitoring, energy management, and power plants.

With no moving parts, the Thermal Mass Flow Meter offers low maintenance, excellent repeatability, minimal pressure loss, and accurate measurement of compressed air, nitrogen, oxygen, biogas, natural gas, and other industrial gases. It is widely used in HVAC, food processing, pharmaceuticals, chemical plants, power generation, energy management, and oil & gas industries for monitoring gas consumption and optimizing process efficiency.

products.title: Fuel Consumption Meter
products.shortDesc: Fuel consumption meter for accurate diesel engine fuel monitoring using dual flow sensor technology.
products.fullDesc:
The Fuel Consumption Meter from Broil Sensotek Industries is an advanced fuel management system designed to accurately measure the actual fuel consumed by diesel engines and generators. The system utilizes two precision oval gear positive displacement flow sensors—one installed in the fuel supply line and the other in the return line—along with an intelligent fuel calculator. By subtracting the return fuel from the supplied fuel, the system provides precise real-time fuel consumption data for improved operational efficiency and fuel management.

The integrated fuel calculator features built-in data storage, displays current flow rate, cumulative totals, running time, supply, return, and actual fuel consumption, and supports RS485, Pulse, Alarm, and 4–20 mA outputs for communication with PLC, SCADA, GPS, and remote monitoring systems. Available in both single-sensor and dual-sensor configurations, the system is suitable for diesel generators, marine engines, mining equipment, construction machinery, agricultural vehicles, trucks, and industrial diesel engines.

Designed for rugged industrial environments, the Fuel Consumption Meter offers high measurement accuracy, low maintenance, durable construction, and reliable long-term performance. It enables industries to reduce fuel wastage, monitor engine efficiency, detect fuel theft, and optimize operating costs through continuous fuel consumption analysis.

products.shortDesc: Coriolis mass flow meter for direct, high-accuracy measurement of mass flow, density, and temperature.
products.fullDesc:
The Coriolis Mass Flow Meter from Broil Sensotek Industries is a premium flow measurement solution that provides direct measurement of mass flow, density, and temperature using the Coriolis effect. Unlike conventional volumetric flow meters, it measures mass flow independent of changes in fluid density, viscosity, pressure, or temperature, making it one of the most accurate technologies available for industrial process measurement.

Available in straight tube, U-tube, and micro-bend designs with integrated or remote display options, the Coriolis meter is suitable for liquids, gases, and high-viscosity fluids. It supports advanced industrial communication protocols including 4–20 mA, Pulse, Alarm, HART, and RS-485, enabling seamless integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, and process automation systems. The meter is widely used in oil & gas, chemical, pharmaceutical, food & beverage, sugar, dairy, pulp & paper, solvent, resin, paint, adhesive, and custody transfer applications where precision is critical.

Manufactured with high-quality SS316L and Hastelloy wetted parts, the instrument is designed for demanding industrial environments and is available with international hazardous-area certifications. The Vibrating Tuning Fork Level Switch with Digital Display from Brotek Instruments is a smart point level detection solution designed for reliable monitoring of liquids, powders, granular materials, and bulk solids. The instrument operates using piezoelectric crystal technology, which excites the tuning fork into resonance. When the fork comes into contact with the process medium, its vibration frequency changes, allowing the integrated electronics to detect the level accurately and generate a switching output. The built-in digital programming display enables easy configuration of switching points and provides real-time monitoring of fork frequency for predictive maintenance.

Engineered for demanding industrial environments, the switch is available with short and long tuning fork designs to suit various applications. It delivers stable operation without requiring on-site calibration and remains unaffected by flow, foam, turbulence, suspended solids, vibration, media characteristics, or material buildup. Advanced self-diagnostic functions continuously monitor frequency, temperature, voltage, and current, while adjustable sensitivity and switching delay simplify commissioning and maintenance. The quick-drip fork design further improves response time, particularly for viscous liquids.

Supporting Relay, PNP, and Frequency outputs, the switch integrates easily with PLC, DCS, and SCADA systems. Constructed with SS316 stainless steel forks, a rugged die-cast aluminum IP66 enclosure, and explosion-proof protection, it is widely used in chemical processing, petrochemical plants, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, water and wastewater treatment, mining, and bulk material handling for high-level and low-level alarms, overflow prevention, and dry-run protection.

products.fullDesc:
The RF Admittance Level Switch from Brotek Instruments is a digital intelligent point level detection device designed for reliable monitoring of liquids, powders, granules, slurries, and conductive or non-conductive materials. Based on the principle of RF capacitance (admittance) measurement, the instrument continuously measures the capacitance between the sensing probe and the vessel wall using an advanced oscillating circuit. Variations in the material level change the capacitance value, allowing the integrated microcontroller to accurately detect the switching point and activate the configured output relay. This measurement method offers excellent stability, fast response, and high immunity to electromagnetic interference.

The switch features a real-time digital capacitance display with simple one-key calibration, enabling automatic setting of alarm points and reducing commissioning time. Its advanced RF admittance technology effectively eliminates false switching caused by probe coating, material buildup, hanging material, dust, or moisture, ensuring dependable performance even in difficult process conditions. A wide selection of SS316, PTFE, Ceramic, and Kynar probes makes the instrument suitable for corrosive, abrasive, high-temperature, and high-pressure applications up to 800°C with ceramic probes and pressures up to 10 MPa.

The RF Admittance Level Switch supports single-point alarm (DPDT), dual-point alarm (2 SPDT), and two-point liquid level control outputs for seamless integration with PLC, DCS, and SCADA systems. It is widely used in chemical and petrochemical plants, refineries, food & beverage processing, pharmaceutical manufacturing, mining, wastewater treatment, and bulk material handling for reliable high-level and low-level alarms and process automation.

products.shortDesc: The Intelligent Thermal Flow Switch from Brotek Instruments provides precise flow monitoring for liquids, gases, and air. Using thermal dispersion technology, it delivers reliable switching, programmable settings, and maintenance-free operation for industrial automation systems.
products.fullDesc:
The Intelligent Thermal Flow Switch from Brotek Instruments is an advanced thermal dispersion flow monitoring device designed for accurate detection of liquids, gases, and air in industrial process applications. The instrument employs a probe containing a heating element and dual temperature sensors. During no-flow conditions, a constant temperature difference is maintained between the sensors. As fluid begins to flow, heat is carried away from the heated sensor, and the resulting temperature difference is continuously measured by a high-precision microprocessor. When the measured flow reaches the programmed set point, the switch changes its output state to provide reliable flow indication and process protection.

Designed as a universal mass flow switch, the instrument measures both liquid and gas flow with the same sensing principle, eliminating moving parts and reducing maintenance requirements. It features programmable settings for alarm value, high/low alarm selection, delay time, zero and span adjustment, and damping factor, allowing easy adaptation to different process conditions. The rugged aluminum enclosure, SS316L wetted parts, and IP66/Ex ia protection ensure dependable performance in harsh industrial environments.

The switch provides a 220 VAC relay output for direct integration with PLC, DCS, SCADA, and industrial automation systems. Supporting flow rates up to 3 m/s for liquids and 30 m/s for gases, it is widely used in HVAC systems, air compressors, refrigeration plants, laser cooling systems, water-cooled welding machines, vacuum coating equipment, electric furnaces, polysilicon production, and general industrial process control where reliable flow detection is essential.

products.shortDesc: The Flexible Bolt Heater is a compact, resistance-based heating element designed for rapid, internal heating of large stud bolts. It expands bolts uniformly from the inside out, enabling safe, fast removal and precise installation without galling.
products.fullDesc:
In the world of industrial maintenance and shutdown operations, time is money. When you're working with massive machinery like turbines, pressure vessels, or large-diameter flanges, even something as small as a bolt can be the bottleneck that holds everything up. Enter the Flexible Bolt Heater – a compact, high-temperature heating device that helps make bolt removal and insertion faster, safer, and more precise.

A flexible bolt heater is a resistance-based heating element, typically inserted into the hollow center of a stud bolt. Unlike surface heating methods, this device heats the bolt from the inside out, expanding it uniformly. Once expanded, the bolt is easier to remove, or in the case of installation, tightens naturally upon cooling to ensure optimal clamping force. This greatly minimizes mechanical stress on casings, avoids thread seizure during bolt removal, and prevents micro-fractures caused by over-tightening.

Where debris, dust, or high air velocities could easily damage, clog, or restrict airflow through delicate finned structures, a smooth tubular heater continues to operate efficiently. Their durability and resistance to fouling make them ideal for rugged industrial drying, curing, and forced-air heating applications where reliability under heavy particulate loads is an absolute requirement.

Bundle heaters are highly durable, engineered electric heaters specifically designed for high-temperature industrial furnace applications, delivering robust and efficient heating for intensive processes like aluminum smelting and steel galvanizing.

Special models are available for applications requiring variable hysteresis, allowing a single device to operate at two different set points. Some models are also available in robust flameproof enclosures for use in hazardous environments.

products.title: Float Magnetic Level Switch
products.shortDesc: The Magnetic Float Level Switch is a highly popular and reliable point-level sensor used to detect the presence or absence of liquids. Utilizing buoyancy and magnetism, it triggers a hermetically sealed reed switch for precise level control.
products.fullDesc:
Sensewell’s Magnetic Float Level Switch is one of the most reliable and popular point-level sensing devices used for detecting the precise presence or absence of liquids across a wide range of industrial applications and vessels (tanks, bins, troughs, standpipes, etc.).

The switch operates seamlessly on the fundamental principles of buoyancy and magnetism. It consists of a specialized float containing an internal magnetic element that rides freely up and down a hollow stem as the fluid level changes. The float's volume and weight are precisely engineered to match the specific gravity (density) of the target fluid. Inside the hollow stem is a hermetically sealed reed switch, positioned at a user-defined actuation point. As the buoyant magnetic float travels past this point, the magnetic field actuates the internal reed switch, instantly sending a highly reliable electrical signal to a PLC, alarm, or pump control system. Float travel is securely contained by retaining clips.

Unlike standard Bourdon tubes which can easily clog, this gauge utilizes a robust circular diaphragm clamped securely between a pair of heavy-duty flanges. When pressure is applied, the physical displacement of the diaphragm is directly transferred via a precision mechanical link to the movement, ensuring highly accurate readings even with sludgy or particulate-heavy media.

Built for demanding environments, the gauge features a weather-proof SS304 case (IP-55/56 rating, upgradable to IP-65) and a highly corrosion-resistant SS316L diaphragm. This rugged construction provides a built-in over-range protection of 1.3 times the maximum scale. It is the ideal measurement solution for low-pressure ranges spanning from 100 mmWC up to 10,000 mmWC, making it indispensable for liquid level measurement, fuel pumps, and heavy sludge pump monitoring.

products.shortDesc: The Compact Diaphragm Seal isolator protects sensitive gauge internals from corrosive, highly viscous, and high-temperature process media up to 600 kg/cm². Featuring all-stainless-steel construction and a TIG-welded diaphragm.
products.fullDesc:
The Compact Diaphragm Sealed (CDS) unit by Brinda Industries (LA Pressure Gauges) is a specialized chemical seal designed to completely isolate the sensitive internal measuring elements of pressure gauges and pressure switches from harsh process fluids. It is the premier protective solution for applications involving highly corrosive media, extremely viscous fluids, sludges, sedimentation, or exceptionally high-temperature processes that would otherwise severely damage standard Bourdon tubes or capsule mechanisms.

The core of the CDS unit is an AISI 316 SS diaphragm that is precision TIG Argon Arc welded directly to the heavy-duty AISI 304 SS body. This permanent, seamless weld ensures absolute physical separation between the process medium and the internal transmitting fluid (Silicon Oil DC-200), entirely preventing cross-contamination or pressure leakages. Engineered as a highly compact, space-saving isolation solution, the CDS supports dynamic pressure ranges extending from -1 up to 600 kg/cm² and continuous process temperatures up to 200°C.

Isolation of delicate gauges from highly corrosive chemical fluids
Accurate pressure measurement of highly viscous fluids and heavy sludges

Comprehensive lineup of Inductive Proximity Switches delivers exceptionally reliable, non-contact detection of metallic objects across highly automated industrial environments. They seamlessly integrate into both standard and highly specialized pneumatic or electric drive systems.

This product card highlights four premier series to cover any application requirement: 1. SIEN Series (Cylindrical): The industry standard cylindrical sensor. Available in threaded housings (M5 to M30) with standard or extended sensing ranges, ideal for general-purpose automation. 2. SIEH Series (High-Pressure): Specifically engineered for high-pressure environments, featuring a robust stainless-steel housing capable of withstanding extreme mechanical stress and direct hydraulic pressure. 4. SIEF Series (Factor 1): The ultimate multi-metal sensor. It provides a uniform sensing distance for all metals (aluminum, steel, copper, brass) without standard reduction factors, making it perfect for multi-material sorting and welding applications.
